description: This file defines the PermissionsHashGenerator class responsible for generating and caching a permissions hash for a user in Drupal, utilizing cache and access policy processing.

classes.name: PermissionsHashGenerator
classes.description: Generates and caches a permissions hash for a user, implementing PermissionsHashGeneratorInterface.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor injecting dependencies: private key, cache backend, and access policy processor.

methods.name: generate
methods.description: Generates a permissions hash for a given account, utilizing cache and access policies.

methods.name: getCacheableMetadata
methods.description: Returns cacheable metadata for the account's access policies.

methods.name: hash
methods.description: Creates a SHA-256 hash of the given string, combining private key and salt.
